Independent implementation and launch-gate reviews with every confirmed material finding closed

decisions: The user authorized continued recovery engineering after reconnecting AC power; production training still requires a fresh exact confirmation bound to the final r12 canonical gate SHA-256.
r11 is permanently consumed and is inspect-only; its dispatch and attempt markers remain permanent and no r11 process or child namespace may be created.

Task Scheduler COM through Schedule.Service and IRegisteredTask.RunEx is selected because the r11 evidence proves svchost-owned supervision, dispatcher-exit survival, exact success and failure exits, and dual marker refusal.

Plain Task Scheduler is weaker because its inspected canary lacks a dispatcher-level permanent marker; WMI lacks complete terminal success evidence; CREATE_BREAKAWAY_FROM_JOB lacks completed terminal evidence.
The r12 long canary must last at least 180 seconds because the accepted r11 systemd canary did not cover the 31-second production reset window.
Task Scheduler task state is not authoritative for scientific lineage; append-only lifecycle, atomic WSL exit evidence, exact child execution state, and terminal validation remain authoritative.
The proposed fresh production namespace is paper-text-v1-multiseed-cap128-r12-20260830 with ordered seeds 42 and 43; publication of that namespace in a gate is not launch authorization.
evidence: The r11 journal records its transient systemd unit starting at 2026-08-30T16:16:00+07:00, WSL Exception at 16:16:31, and a new WSL kernel at 16:16:58.
The r11 lifecycle stops at stable_locks_ready, stdout and stderr are empty, both children are absent, post-failure phase is process_missing, and neither process_exited nor terminal validation exists.

The r11 Task Scheduler COM success canary records a svchost-owned supervisor, WSL exit 0, terminal_validated, permanent dispatch and attempt refusal; its forced-failure case records WSL exit 23 and terminal_validation_failed.
